# Augment Code

> > Augment Code is an AI-powered software development platform featuring Context Engine, autonomous agents, and enterprise-grade code review tools.

Augment Code provides AI coding agents that achieve top performance on benchmarks like SWE-Bench Verified and SWE-Bench Pro. The platform integrates with Claude 3.7, Claude Sonnet 4, and other leading models to deliver context-aware code generation, automated code review, and autonomous development capabilities for individual developers and enterprises.

## Key Topics

- Context Engine
- AI Agents
- SWE-Bench Verified
- Claude 3.7 & Sonnet 4
- Auggie CLI
- Code Review Automation
